Delaney Hall’s failures aren’t about enforcement—they’re about GEO Group’s mismanagement. The Humane Accountability Act (H.R. 3473) proves D.C. would rather fund bureaucratic oversight than fix systemic issues. Taxpayers paid GEO $20M+ to reopen this facility, yet visitors bake in 100°F heat while detainees report overcrowding and medical neglect.

This isn’t “humane treatment”—it’s a contractor profiting from chaos. ICE’s mandate is security, but outsourcing to firms with abuse records undermines enforcement. Newark’s Code Red alerts should’ve forced shelter protocols, yet GEO ignored basic safety.

Real accountability means canceling contracts, not performative letters.
